原子弹，一层一层。: An atom bomb, layer by layer.

内部亮度表示累计能量，不是温度测量。: The inner glow represents accumulated energy, not a temperature measurement.
微观示意停在前 12 代，读数对应主时间轴。: The microscopic illustration stays within the first 12 generations; readings follow the main timeline.
哈恩和施特拉斯曼发现铀核裂变；迈特纳和弗里施于 1939 年初发表解释。: Hahn and Strassmann discover uranium fission; Meitner and Frisch publish its explanation in early 1939.
第一次由人实现的自持核链式反应。: The first human-made, self-sustaining nuclear chain reaction.
第一次核爆炸试验，使用内爆式装置。: The first nuclear explosion, using an implosion device.
8 月 6 日广岛、8 月 9 日长崎遭原子弹轰炸；至 1945 年底，广岛死亡: Hiroshima is bombed on 6 August and Nagasaki on 9 August; estimated deaths by the end of 1945 are 90,000–166,000 and 60,000–80,000, respectively.
苏联进行第一次核试验。: The Soviet Union conducts its first nuclear test.
第一次全尺寸两级热核试验。: The first full-scale test of a two-stage thermonuclear device.
试验当量约为 15 百万吨 TNT。: The test releases approximately 15 megatons of TNT equivalent.
约 50 百万吨 TNT，是已进行核试验中的最大当量。: At about 50 megatons of TNT, the largest nuclear test ever conducted.
部分禁止核试验条约签署。: The Partial Test Ban Treaty is signed.
596 试验成功；同一天，中国政府声明在任何时候、任何情况下都不首先使用核武器。: After the 596 test, China declares the same day that it will never initiate nuclear use, regardless of time or circumstances.
第六次核试验，当量 3.3 百万吨 TNT；本展不展示其内部构型。: Test No. 6 releases 3.3 megatons of TNT equivalent; this exhibit does not show its internal configuration.
不扩散核武器条约开放签署。: The Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons opens for signature.
全面禁止核试验条约开放签署。: The Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty opens for signature.
沿着日期，读这些事件。: Follow the dates. Read the events.
按事件排列，间隔不代表时长: Events in order; spacing does not represent duration
每个事件的出处，都可以打开。: Open the source for any event.
从第一颗原子弹到第一颗氢弹: From the first atomic bomb to the first hydrogen bomb
从第一次原子弹试验到第一次两级或百万吨级热核试验的完整月数: Whole months between the first atomic test and the first two-stage or megaton-scale thermonuclear test
只计完整月，不向上取整。: Whole months only; no rounding up.
以各国第一次两级热核或百万吨级热核试验为准，日期见维基百科各条目。: Uses each country’s first two-stage or megaton-scale thermonuclear test. Dates are linked to the corresponding Wikipedia entries.
1 千吨以下只比较能量，不画效应圈: Below 1 kt, only energy is compared. Effect rings are not shown.
1 吨，约为一辆轻型卡车的载重。: One ton, roughly the payload of a light truck.
高度参照：300 米的塔，8,848 米的山。: Height references: a 300 m tower and an 8,848 m mountain.
按 Glasstone & Dolan《核武器效应》的教科书缩放律：空中最优高度: Textbook scaling from Glasstone & Dolan’s The Effects of Nuclear Weapons: an airburst at the textbook optimum height, flat ground and clear skies. Actual effects depend on terrain, buildings and weather. The city grid is abstract and represents no real city.
